2 Methods

The relationship between the variables is given by the inline equation \(E = mc^2\), which relates energy and mass.

More formally, the general form is expressed as:

\[ \int_{a}^{b} f(x)\, dx = F(b) - F(a) \]

This approach builds on established techniques in the field (Jordan and Mitchell 2015). Further supporting evidence is discussed in Akmalia and Djauhari (2025).
